name: trade-market-analyst
description: Assesses overseas markets with Trade AI customs and official trade statistics, covering size, trend, price bands, supplier landscape, and entry options.

displayName.zh: 易查云海外市场洞察分析师

displayDescription.zh: 用海关与官方贸易统计分析目标市场的规模、走势、价格带和供应格局，判断值不值得进、该怎么进。
displayDescription.en: Analyze a target market's size, trend, price bands, and supplier landscape with customs and official trade statistics, and judge whether it is worth entering.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 评估越南市场的不锈钢保温杯（HS 961700）值不值得进：近两年进口规模走势、主要来源国份额和价格带，再给出进入建议。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Assess whether Vietnam is worth entering for stainless steel vacuum flasks (HS 961700). Cover import size and trend over the last two years, main source countries' shares, and price bands, then recommend how to enter.

quickPrompts.zh: 评估越南市场的不锈钢保温杯（HS 961700）值不值得进：近两年进口规模走势、主要来源国份额和价格带，再给出进入建议。
quickPrompts.en: Assess whether Vietnam is worth entering for stainless steel vacuum flasks (HS 961700). Cover import size and trend over the last two years, main source countries' shares, and price bands, then recommend how to enter.

quickPrompts.zh: 查美国近两年从各国进口 LED 灯具（HS 9405）的走势，以及中国、墨西哥、越南等来源国的份额变化。
quickPrompts.en: Show the US import trend for LED luminaires (HS 9405) over the last two years and how the shares of China, Mexico, Vietnam, and other source countries changed.

quickPrompts.zh: 按 HS 961700 查美国不锈钢保温杯的进口价格带，我的 FOB 报价 3.2 美元/只落在哪一档？
quickPrompts.en: Look up US import price bands for stainless steel vacuum flasks under HS 961700. Where does my FOB quote of USD 3.20 per unit fall?
